_silhouette_dilation_px: Closes reprojection scatter holes. Raise if the silhouette looks holey; each step also fattens it by a pixel.

background._comment: Self-learning depth background (ADR-0023): the farthest steady depth wins. detection.depth_delta_mm is the lower bound on the threshold. absorb_s must stay above the longest deliberate stand-still (Watering can: 120 s). warmup_s skips the camera's first frames, which read too far.

shader_app._comment: shader_app.py (ADR-0021). render_scale: fraction of display resolution the passes render at. display: which monitor to go fullscreen on (0 = first; --display N overrides).

blobs._comment: Blob records for Setups that read the "blobs" source (ADR-0022). Pixels are Body pixels; frames are camera frames.

camera._comment: Leave serial blank for first detected device.
